description: This file provides utility functions for handling Node.js Buffer operations, including conversions, allocations, encoding, and random bytes generation, specifically tailored for BSON processing in Node.js environments.

methods.name: export function nodejsMathRandomBytes(byteLength: number) { nodejsMathRandomBytes
methods.description: Generates a Uint8Array of random bytes using Math.random as a fallback if crypto.randomBytes is unavailable.

methods.name: nodeJsByteUtils.toLocalBufferType
methods.description: Converts various potentialBuffer types to a NodeJsBuffer, throwing an error if conversion is not possible.

methods.name: nodeJsByteUtils.allocate
methods.description: Allocates a buffer of specified size.

methods.name: nodeJsByteUtils.allocateUnsafe
methods.description: Allocates an unsafe buffer of specified size.

methods.name: nodeJsByteUtils.fromNumberArray
methods.description: Creates a Buffer from an array of numbers.

methods.name: nodeJsByteUtils.fromBase64
methods.description: Creates a Buffer from a Base64 encoded string.

methods.name: nodeJsByteUtils.toBase64
methods.description: Converts a Uint8Array buffer to a Base64 string.

methods.name: nodeJsByteUtils.fromISO88591
methods.description: Creates a Buffer from a string using the ISO-8859-1 encoding (legacy).

methods.name: nodeJsByteUtils.toISO88591
methods.description: Converts a buffer to a string using the ISO-8859-1 encoding (legacy).

methods.name: nodeJsByteUtils.fromHex
methods.description: Creates a Buffer from a hex string.

methods.name: nodeJsByteUtils.toHex
methods.description: Converts a buffer to a hex string.

methods.name: nodeJsByteUtils.toUTF8
methods.description: Decodes a buffer segment to a UTF-8 string, with special handling for small buffers.

methods.name: nodeJsByteUtils.utf8ByteLength
methods.description: Calculates the byte length of a UTF-8 string.

methods.name: nodeJsByteUtils.encodeUTF8Into
methods.description: Encodes a string into a buffer at a specified byte offset.

methods.name: nodeJsByteUtils.randomBytes
methods.description: A function to generate random bytes, either from crypto or Math.random fallback.

methods.name: nodeJsByteUtils.swap32
methods.description: Swaps the byte order in a buffer for 32-bit data.
